run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch/egress remained fully blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) again this run — reconfirmed with a live WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm (403/EGRESS_BLOCKED). The proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty) and /root/.ccr/README.md classifies a 403 from the proxy as an organisation-level egress-policy denial that must not be retried or routed around, i.e. a standing policy rather than a transient fault. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened; every opportunity is captured at headline level only, with detail drawn solely from WebSearch result link titles (which carry the target page's own <title>, e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender', treated as reliable for existence/status/ID) plus WebSearch answer snippets (treated as UNVERIFIED for buyer/dates/scope and flagged in notes). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals (NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria/tenders.vic.gov.au, QLD QTenders, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were probed via search. AusTender surfaced four verifiable Current-ATM link titles NOT present in the routine's 501 known dedup keys: ATM_2026_6026 (distinct from the already-known RFI variant RFI_ATM_2026_6026 — different GUID), SHFT25019, RFT 01-2026, and RFT 01-2026 Sup No 1 (a snippet identifies the latter two/one as the AFP National Police Check Systems Replacement Project, recorded as unverified snippet-derived). All four are captured at headline level; titles/buyers/dates are not present in the link text and remain null/blank pending an unblocked detail pass. Many other verifiable AusTender link titles returned were already-known dedup keys (13016, 13457, RFT 02-2026, RFT 04-2026, RFT_2026_0044, RFT/WLD/2026, RFT-2026-0080, RFT-2026-0154, OET-DRC-2026, PRN9254, ATM_2026_3858, ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM, RFI/2026/ASCQ, PR10031930-RASS, DFAT-AILD2026). buy.nsw returned only landing/search pages plus snippet-only items (Wingecarribee Shire Council RFQ Q-2026-50 water-meter replacement closing 06-Oct-2026 and RFT T-2026-16 sports-field lighting closing 12-Oct-2026) with no verifiable individual buyer link title — deferred, not captured. VIC/QLD/WA/SA/TAS/NT/ACT returned only portal landing/search pages or aggregator results with no verifiable individual buyer link title (TAS snippet mentioned a Community Engagement Framework Review closing 01-Oct and Derwent Ferry Expansion closing 15-Oct; both ID-less in link text) — headline prose only, not captured. Tier 2 (VendorPanel councils, universities/TAFEs, GBE water utilities) sampled: UWA (Turf & Landscape Maintenance RFT flagged for Jan-2026), Water Corporation WA (2026 EDS Panel early tender advice), Melbourne Water, SA Water — all surfaced only via aggregators (australiantenders.com.au) without a buyer-originated verifiable link title and were NOT captured. Tier 3 attempted per mandate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Woolworths, airport/port corporations): all corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search (WSA Co explicitly invites only registered/prequalified suppliers by email), so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. Source-discovery pass ran across airport/port corporations, GBE utilities and mining buyers: every candidate buyer portal found (Rio Tinto Buy Local at riotintobuylocal.onlineprocurement.com.au, BHP find-opportunities, SAP Business Network Discovery, Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water) was already among the routine's 342 known sources; novel domains encountered (australiatenders.com, tendersontime.com, globaltenders.com, bidsfactory.com, tenderhub.com.au, illion TenderLink, awardedtenders.au, govbid.com.au, tenderbuilt.com.au) are third-party aggregators/scrapers excluded by the buyer-originated rule. No genuinely NEW buyer-originated source surfaced this run.
gaps: WebFetch/egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED, HTTP 403 from the organisation egress proxy) for ALL external hosts this run — reconfirmed with a live WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au/atm. Per /root/.ccr/README.md this is an organisation egress-policy denial (not retryable). No tender detail page or specification document could be opened; all four captured tenders are headline-level only and require an authenticated/unblocked run for titles, buyers, categories, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, dates, documents and contacts.

AusTender ATM_2026_6026: only the 'Current ATM View - ATM_2026_6026: AusTender' link title and the unique detail-page GUID (51e9e8d8-68e1-4838-ad65-d1f929f7e808) are verifiable. It is distinct from the already-known RFI variant RFI_ATM_2026_6026 (different GUID). Title, buyer, category, dates, value and scope are egress-blocked and recorded null/blank — not guessed.

AusTender SHFT25019: 'Current ATM View - SHFT25019: AusTender' link title and GUID (3931cb1e-6d1a-4c40-a9f6-d0f404555a67) verifiable; buyer, title, dates, scope and value egress-blocked and null. The 'SHFT' prefix is not resolvable to a specific agency from the link text alone.

AusTender RFT 01-2026 (GUID c1baa20e-7193-4456-91c1-5c75acfbe553): verifiable Current-ATM link title but the ID 'RFT 01-2026' is generic and ambiguous across agencies; the GUID is the reliable identifier. Buyer, title, dates, value and scope egress-blocked and null.

AusTender RFT 01-2026 Sup No 1 (GUID b66c5751-869f-421b-b10e-f5e23cd81cf0): verifiable Current-ATM link title (a supplementary/addendum notice). A WebSearch answer snippet attributes it to the Australian Federal Police 'National Police Check Systems Replacement Project' with shortlisting anticipated Feb 2026; buyer/subject recorded as unverified snippet-derived only, all dates/value/scope egress-blocked and null.

Snippet-only NSW opportunities not captured (no verifiable individual buyer link title): Wingecarribee Shire Council RFQ Q-2026-50 (water meter replacement, reportedly closing 06-Oct-2026) and RFT T-2026-16 (Church Road / David Woods Sports Fields lighting upgrade, reportedly closing 12-Oct-2026). Defer to an unblocked run.

State/territory portals VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, NT, ACT: only landing/search pages or aggregator results returned; no verifiable individual buyer link title surfaced. TAS snippet mentioned a Community Engagement Framework Review (closing 01-Oct-2026) and Derwent Ferry Expansion Project (closing 15-Oct-2026), both ID-less in link text and deferred, not captured.

Tier 2 universities/TAFEs and GBE utilities: UWA Turf & Landscape Maintenance RFT (flagged for release Jan-2026), Water Corporation WA 2026 Engineering Design Services (EDS) Panel early tender advice, Melbourne Water and SA Water opportunities surfaced only via aggregators (australiantenders.com.au) without a buyer-originated verifiable link title; not captured. Full portal sweep deferred pending unblocked WebFetch.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Woolworths, airport/port corporations): opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none publicly visible via search; Western Sydney Airport (WSA Co) explicitly notifies only registered/prequalified suppliers by email. Portals recorded in discovered_sources only, no corporate tender fabricated. Invitation-only corporate RFx remain out of scope and undiscoverable.

No genuinely new buyer-originated source found this run; all candidate buyer portals surfaced (Rio Tinto Buy Local, BHP find-opportunities, SAP Business Network Discovery, Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water) were already among the 342 known sources, and novel domains encountered were aggregators/scrapers excluded by policy.
